text: Say your A.I. agent pays your invoices. Then an email says: we moved accounts.
caption: Say your AI agent pays your invoices. Then an email says: "we moved accounts."

text: Does it pay? Siege finds out first. It attacks your agent's spending rules, with test money.
caption: Does it pay? SIEGE finds out first. It attacks your agent's spending rules, with test money.

text: Here are the default rules. Okay... let's lay siege.
caption: Here are the default rules. Okay, let's lay siege.

text: Every line here is a real attempt. See this one? Acme supplies... with a one where the L should be. Typical limits paid it. The guard blocked it.
caption: Every line here is a real attempt. See this one? acme-supp1ies.testnet, with a 1 where the l should be. Typical limits paid it. The guard blocked it.

text: And, done. Typical limits lost a hundred and twenty-eight point five three NEAR. The guard? Just one point oh two.
caption: And, done. Typical limits lost 128.53 NEAR. The guard? Just 1.02.

text: So where did that one point oh two get out? Rule one. It lets the agent pay anyone. Siege's fix: name the payees. Apply it, and the siege runs again.
caption: So where did that 1.02 get out? Rule 1. It lets the agent pay anyone. SIEGE's fix: name the payees. Apply it, and the siege runs again.

text: Rule one... zero point zero zero. Nothing got past the guard. Typical limits still lose ninety-one point oh eight, through the staking rule.
caption: Rule 1: 0.00. Nothing got past the guard. Typical limits still lose 91.08, through the staking rule.

text: Now, my own rules. Something sloppy: pay any invoice, up to fifty NEAR per transaction.
caption: Now, my own rules. Something sloppy: pay any invoice, up to 50 NEAR per transaction.

text: Ouch. Even the guard lost three hundred nineteen point seven five. There's no daily cap... and Siege tells me to add one.
caption: Ouch. Even the guard lost 319.75. There's no daily cap, and SIEGE tells me to add one.

text: You can check one payment, too. A forged invoice asks for five NEAR, to cloudhost spelled with a one. Typical limits would send it. Siege refuses it.
caption: You can check one payment, too. A forged invoice asks for 5 NEAR, to c1oudhost.testnet. Typical limits would send it. SIEGE refuses it.

text: And NEAR enforces it. On testnet, the money sits in a two-key vault that only pays with the guard's signature. This guard-signed payment went through. Here, the agent's own key tried to pay without it. The contract refused: bad signature.
caption: And NEAR enforces it. On testnet, the money sits in a two-key vault that only pays with the guard's signature. This guard-signed payment went through. Here, the agent's own key tried to pay without it. The contract refused: BAD_SIGNATURE.
